# 🎯 FrozenBounty

> **Set bounties. Hunt players. Claim rewards.**
> A fully-featured cross-server bounty system for Paper & Folia servers.

---

## ✨ Features

- 💰 **Bounty System** — Players can set money bounties on any other player
- 🖥️ **Paginated GUI** — Clean 6-row chest GUI showing all active bounties with player skulls
- 🔍 **Search** — Search bounties by player name directly from the GUI
- 🔃 **Sort Modes** — Toggle between sorting by highest bounty amount or most recently set
- ✅ **Confirmation GUI** — 3-row confirm screen before any money is charged
- 💵 **Economy Support** — Works with **Vault** (any economy plugin) or **FrozenVault**
- 🗄️ **MySQL Support** — Full cross-server bounty sync via MySQL database
- 📄 **YAML Fallback** — Works out of the box with no database setup required
- ⚡ **Folia Ready** — Fully compatible with both Paper and Folia schedulers
- 🏷️ **Hex Colors** — All messages and GUIs use rich hex color formatting

---

## 📸 Preview

| Bounty List GUI | Confirm GUI |
|---|---|
| Paginated player skulls sorted by amount or time | 3-slot confirm/cancel screen before charging |

---

## 📋 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/bounty` | Open the bounty list GUI |
| `/bounties` | Alias for `/bounty` |
| `/bounty add <player> <amount>` | Place a bounty on a player |
| `/bounty <player>` | Check a specific player's bounty |

---

## 🔑 Permissions

| Permission | Description | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `frozenbounty.use` | Access to all bounty commands and GUI | `true` |
| `frozenbounty.admin` | Admin permissions | `op` |

---

## ⚙️ Configuration

```yaml
# FrozenBounty Configuration

# Economy type: 'vault' or 'frozenvault'
economy:
  type: vault

# MySQL settings (enable for cross-server bounty sync)
mysql:
  enabled: false
  host: localhost
  port: 3306
  database: frozenbounty
  username: root
  password: ''
  pool-size: 10
```

---

## 🔗 Dependencies

| Dependency | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| [Vault](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/vault.34315/) | Soft | Required if `economy.type: vault` |
| FrozenVault | Soft | Required if `economy.type: frozenvault` |

## 🖥️ Compatibility

| | Supported |

| **Folia** | ✅ 1.21 – 1.21.x |
| **Java** | ✅ Java 21+ |

## 📦 Cross-Server Setup

Enable MySQL in `config.yml` and point all your servers to the same database — bounties will sync instantly across your entire network.

```yaml
mysql:
  enabled: true
  host: your.database.host
  port: 3306
  database: frozenbounty
  username: youruser
  password: yourpassword
```
